title: Comment
description: User comment on a post or content item with author information, content, engagement metrics, and timestamps. Used for social media platforms, blogs, forums, and content discussion systems.

post_id.description: Foreign key reference to the post or content item this comment is on

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who wrote the comment

created_at.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

likes.description: Number of likes or positive reactions the comment has received
